negotiation.glycemic_gap: A 40-minute walk on Monday can't clear the glucose spike from a sedentary Tuesday dinner. Each meal creates its own blood sugar response — covering more days matters more than longer walks.

negotiation.congrats_great_target: Amazing — you've hit a very good target — in fact better than most of us! Keep it up — you can still add walking days at your wish.
